abstract: This paper provides a solution to the evaluation of treatment effects in selective samples when neither instruments nor parametric assumptions are available. We provide sharp bounds for average treatment effects under a conditional monotonicity assumption for all principal strata, i.e. units characterizing the complete intensive and extensive margins. Most importantly, we allow for a large share of units whose selection is indifferent to treatment, e.g. due to non-compliance. The existence of such a population is crucially tied to the regularity of sharp population bounds and thus conventional asymptotic inference for methods such as Lee bounds can be misleading. This problem can be solved using smoothed outer identification regions for inference. We provide semiparametrically efficient debiased machine learning estimators for both regular and smooth bounds that can accommodate high-dimensional covariates and flexible functional forms. Our study of active labor market policy reveals the empirical prevalence of the aforementioned indifference population and supports results from previous impact analyses under much weaker assumptions.
title: Treatment evaluation at the intensive and extensive margins

abstract: Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) countries have made notable progress in reducing income inequality; however, the distributional incidence of water and sanitation expenditures across the income distribution remains poorly understood. In this sector, disparities emerge as lower-income households may encounter reduced access to clean water, utilize less water, or bear a disproportionately higher financial burden than higher-income households. In this paper, we document the distributional incidence of water expenditures in the water and sanitation sector in LAC. We compute and compare concentration indices for water expenditures and income for Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay using survey data from the AmericasBarometer of the Latin American Public Opinion Project (LAPOP). Our descriptive analysis shows that low-income households allocate a larger share of their income to water expenditures than high-income households. Comparing the concentration curve for water expenditures to the Lorenz curve for each country, we find that water expenditures are more evenly distributed across households than income, an inherently regressive pattern given that households spend similar absolute amounts regardless of income level. We further show that total water expenditures, encompassing piped water, bottled water, and water delivered by trucks, are distributed more similarly to income than piped water alone in Brazil, Costa Rica, and Uruguay, while the opposite holds for Colombia. We discuss how these cross-country differences are consistent with variation in water tariff subsidy designs and with the higher propensity of wealthier households to substitute toward bottled water.
title: Water expenditure, service quality and distributional outcomes in Latin America and the Caribbean

abstract: International aid is increasingly directed toward countries characterized by weak governance, institutional instability, and conflict, where achieving development outcomes is highly uncertain. As key governance actors in aid projects, donor agencies play an important role in driving project success. However, empirical evidence remains limited on how the relationship between donor project governance and project outcomes varies across recipient-country governance environments. To fill this gap, this study examines how recipient-country governance and donor project governance—both directly and jointly—relate to aid project outcomes. We compile a dataset of 6,773 World Bank projects completed in 167 countries between 1996 and 2025, linking Independent Evaluation Group (IEG) project performance ratings with the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI). Our results indicate that donor project governance is positively associated with project success. This association is stronger in weaker-governance environments, indicating a compensatory pattern. However, when aiming for the highest levels of project performance, a complementary relationship emerges, in which donor project governance becomes more effective as recipient-country governance improves. A similar complementary pattern is observed in fragile and conflict-affected situations (FCS). Overall, donor project governance is important but context-dependent and bounded. It can partially alleviate institutional constraints in weak-governance settings, but cannot fully substitute for recipient-country governance capacity. These results highlight the need for donor agencies to adopt differentiated governance strategies tailored to local institutional conditions and project performance objectives.
title: Can strong donor governance rescue projects in weak-governance recipient countries? Evidence from the World Bank

abstract: This paper investigates whether news consumers react strategically to media slant. Using data from Microblog users and an online experiment that varies whether sources and stances are disclosed, we find that users are more likely to repost news consistent with their own attitudes, yet they also exhibit a higher propensity to repost news inconsistent with the reporting outlet’s general stance. Evidence suggests that this latter behavior reflects strategic inference: users recognize the outlet’s tradeoff between popularity and stance, and thus infer greater popularity for inconsistent news. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that users with stronger Bayesian updating and level-k reasoning abilities display larger strategic reactions. Finally, we show that simply reminding users of media slant can serve as an effective nudge to foster more strategic responses. This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis. abstract: Information distortion and incentive misalignment often undermine supply chain performance. In response, many firms adopt a “control tower” approach, whereby one party assumes responsibility for replenishment decisions across the supply chain. Industry examples showed that this role may be assigned to the customer, Customer-Managed Inventory (CMI), or to the supplier, Supplier-Managed Inventory (SMI). This paper investigates when one governance structure is preferable. We study a two-echelon, one-to-many supply chain consisting of a single supplier and a customer operating multiple warehouses. We characterize optimal base-stock policies and equilibrium holding-cost-sharing parameters under CMI and SMI and benchmark them against decentralized operations and a fully centralized system. Two primary forces shape the choice between CMI and SMI: the relative shortage penalty costs of the two parties and the structure of the customer’s distribution network. Specifically, CMI is preferred when the customer faces relatively higher shortage penalties and operates in a more asymmetric environment—for example, when demand is concentrated in a subset of its warehouses or when replenishment lead times vary substantially across these locations. In contrast, SMI is favored under opposite conditions. We further examine how intertemporal and interspatial demand correlations affect this comparison. A key finding is that, although neither CMI nor SMI achieves the first-best outcome, their efficiency loss relative to full centralization is typically small. Calibrated numerical studies based on four industry cases disentangle the incremental value of information sharing, decision-right transfer, and cost sharing, showing that most performance gains stem from decision-right transfer supported by appropriate holding-cost sharing. This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02137 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Who Directs the Control Tower? Customer vs. Supplier-Managed Inventory in Supply Chains

abstract: China launched a nationwide, rate-based carbon market in 2021. Covering the world’s top CO2 emitter, compliance depends on the intensity of carbon emissions rather than an absolute cap. We draw on the theoretical literature of rate-based systems to provide the first empirical evidence on an early adopter. Using plant-level data from satellite imagery and machine learning methods, we find that high-e!ciency power plants increased electricity generation and CO2 emissions by approximately 5% relative to low-e!ciency plants. Because its carbon market regulates nearly all coal plants in China, we focus on the differential responses by plant efficiency, finding no evidence of a differential reduction in emission intensity (though these estimates are imprecise). Relative to coal plants in Indonesia and the Philippines, which had no carbon market, China’s high-efficiency plants also increased emissions, while the estimate for its low-efficiency plants is small and insignificant. This pattern of responses suggests that emissions increases of high-efficiency plants exceeded substitution away from low-efficiency plants. Underscoring the production stimulus to more efficient Chinese plants, air quality worsened downwind of high-efficiency plants relative to low-efficiency plants, compromising air quality in relatively clean areas of China. To curb the level of China’s carbon emissions and thereby slow climate change, benchmarks need to be tightened within the existing system or an alternative system adopted that does not simultaneously incentivize electricity production.

abstract: Assessing determinants of emissions paths is critical to climate policymaking. Since energy technology uncertainty has profound and prevalent impacts on future emissions paths, examining the emissions determinants under technology uncertainty is essential to identify robust mitigation measures. However, a formal characterization of the uncertain patterns of emissions determinants is lacking in the literature, which further makes the uncertainty in emissions determinants implicitly quantified. To address this gap, we introduce a probabilistic approach to index decomposition analysis. The uncertain patterns of determinants are first characterized using the nonparametric kernel method, based on which probabilistic methods are adapted to measure the degrees of uncertainties in the determinants and examine their uncertain roles. The proposed approach is thus able to quantify the uncertain determinants of future emissions paths under technology uncertainty. Applying the proposed model to China's electricity sector reveals the evidently uncertain determinants and their overall pattern under technology uncertainty throughout 2060. While phasing out fossil electricity and deploying CCS are two robust mitigation measures, the emissions effects of energy intensity improvement and greening fossil electricity structure are fairly unstable. Policy implications of the results are further discussed.

abstract: We construct an index of industry exposure to artificial intelligence (AI) to calibrate a multi-sector macroeconomic model. Building on studies that find significant increases in workers’ output from AI, we model AI as a permanent increase in total factor productivity that differs by industry. At the aggregate level, AI significantly raises output, consumption and investment in the short and long run. AI adoption generates inflationary pressures in the long run due to general equilibrium demand effects, but disinflation can occur in the short to medium term if households and firms do not anticipate higher future productivity from AI. Inspecting individual industries and performing counterfactual exercises, we find that an industry’s initial exposure to AI has little relationship to its long-term increase in output. However, output grows by twice as much for the same increase in aggregate productivity when AI affects industries producing consumption rather than investment goods, thanks to second round effects through sectoral linkages.
title: The impact of artificial intelligence on output and inflation

abstract: Large differences in employment stability are a key feature of the labor market, with unstable careers leading to reduced pension entitlements and lower life-cycle wealth accumulation. This paper studies how optimal pension systems should account for heterogeneity in employment stability. I develop a novel life-cycle model that features heterogeneous job-separation risk with endogenous human capital accumulation, consumption-saving behavior, and retirement decisions in a frictional labor market. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the optimal pension system is substantially more progressive than the current Social Security system, with an optimal benefit schedule that approaches a benefit floor. Abolishing the Social Security cap further increases progressivity; together, these reforms generate welfare gains equivalent to 0.94% of lifetime consumption for new labor market entrants. Although higher progressivity distorts human capital investment and reduces labor supply, the insurance gains dominate. The optimal pension system provides substantial insurance against heterogeneous career risk and reduces consumption inequality over the life cycle.
title: Optimal progressive pension systems and heterogeneous labor market risk

abstract: This paper studies whether government-issued skill certification improves labor market integration when workers’ skills are hard to verify. We evaluate a randomized offer of access to an occupation-specific certification program in Colombia among locals and migrants, two groups with different ex ante signaling capacity. The program certifies existing skills rather than providing training. Among locals, the offer increases employment by reducing inactivity and raises hours worked. The effects persist unevenly over time and are robust to attrition bounds and alternative outcome measures. Among migrants, estimates are less precise and provide no evidence of effects in employment, hours, or wages. The results show that a common skill certification generates different patterns of labor-market adjustment among locals and migrants.
title: Skill certifications and migrant labor market integration: Experimental evidence from Colombia

abstract: I develop a control function methodology robust to endogenous or mismeasured regressors in hazard models. Applying the estimator to the subprime mortgage crisis, I quantify what caused the foreclosure rate to triple across the 2003 to 2007 subprime cohorts. To identify the elasticity of default to housing prices, I use various home price instruments including historical variation in home price cyclicality. Loose credit played a significant role in the crisis, but much of the increase in defaults across cohorts was caused by price declines unrelated to lending standards, with a 10% price decline increasing subprime mortgage default rates by 50%.
title: An IV Hazard Model of Loan Default with an Application to Subprime Mortgage Cohorts

abstract: Rationalizability by a weak order is perhaps the fundamental property of concern in rational choice theory. On the domain of all finite menus, it admits a characterization by a very simple, apparently novel axiom of atypical form. The axiom makes clear how weak order rationalizability strengthens Path Independence. On arbitrary domains, it is strictly weaker than many standard conditions that are equivalent to weak order rationalizability on the full domain. Simple domain conditions restore equivalence with the conjunction of Sen’s Properties α and β and with weak order rationalizability.
title: A simple single-axiom characterization of weak order rationalizability

abstract: This paper studies the implications of introducing anticipated future consumption (AFC) into the canonical OLG model. Current utility depends on both contemporaneous consumption and anticipated future consumption, which may refer to own future consumption (internal AFC) or economy-wide average future consumption (external AFC). First, we show that AFC makes the interior saving rule interest-rate dependent. Second, we characterize the equilibrium dynamics and establish global convergence. With jealous AFC, the equilibrium always follows the interior solution. With altruistic AFC, equilibrium dynamics may feature regime switching between boundary and interior solutions governed by an endogenous threshold capital level. Third, AFC is non-neutral in the OLG steady state whenever it is interior. This contrasts with infinite-horizon representative-agent models under commitment, in which AFC does not affect admissible steady states or balanced-growth paths. Starting from a common initial condition, the two models generate the same capital path while both follow the common boundary branch. Once the paths separate, internal AFC generates more capital under altruism and less under jealousy. Their long-run capital stocks differ except when AFC is absent, both economies converge to extinction under sufficiently jealous AFC, or both reach the common boundary steady state under sufficiently altruistic AFC. Time inconsistency is structurally absent in the canonical two-period OLG model because agents have no remaining choice when old. Finally, for external AFC, we characterize when a corrective capital-income tax or subsidy internalizes the within-cohort AFC externality.
title: Anticipated future consumption in the canonical OLG model

abstract: Using the Uganda National Panel Survey, I document that farmers face a trade-off between crop yields and risk, that most grow both high- and low-yield crops, and that poorer farmers concentrate on the low-yield, low-risk ones. I then develop an incomplete-markets model with a crop-portfolio choice, in which households trade off income returns against consumption smoothing. Wealth-poor households optimally under-invest in intermediates and shift toward safer crops. Crop portfolios, intermediate input use, and the wealth distribution are jointly determined in equilibrium. The model also reproduces the low pass-through of both income inequality and income volatility into consumption. Calibrated to rural Uganda, it implies that completing markets raises agricultural productivity by 12.8%, with 15.8% of the gain coming from eliminating the misallocation of inputs across farmers and crops. Consumption rises by 17.6% and welfare by 17.4%, with income inequality rising slightly and consumption inequality unchanged.
title: Incomplete markets, crop portfolios, and agricultural productivity

abstract: This paper studies how hukou-based education wedges and child-arrangement costs jointly shape welfare and intergenerational educational mobility in China. I develop a quantitative spatial model with overlapping generations in which households sequentially choose education, migration, and child arrangement, and estimate it using census and household-survey data. Under a common financing rule, two child-targeted policies raise the co-migration rate to a similar extent but differ sharply in welfare and mobility. Subsidizing co-migrating families in high-cost destinations generates 1.4 times as much welfare per unit of government revenue as removing migrant children’s education-access wedges. These gains concentrate on recipients. Removing the education-access wedges delivers over four times the mobility gain per unit of revenue, and the resulting human capital generates growing welfare gains across generations. A broader reform that equalizes public-service access for all migrants is the most welfare-efficient but does not raise mobility.

abstract: In 2019, North Dakota repealed its Sunday closing law, which had required most non‐grocery stores to close between midnight and noon. Using this policy change and consumer GPS data, we study the impact of opening hours on shopping behavior and welfare. We compare visits before and after the repeal in North Dakota and neighboring states using difference‐in‐differences and event‐study designs. The repeal caused a large increase in Sunday morning visits, originating partly from intertemporal, store‐type, and cross‐border substitution. The closing law's welfare loss is equivalent to increasing the travel distance to affected stores by about 1.4 miles per consumer.
title: Opening Hours and Consumer Behavior: Evidence From GPS Data and Deregulation

abstract: We introduce an AI industry into a career signaling model in which early-career work both signals a worker's ability and builds her long-run skills. The industry sells tokens, which workers convert into output indistinguishable from their own. Before AI, the market learns every type, and signaling incentives create a rat race in which effort exceeds the full-information level. With tokens the market still learns every type, and a worker separates by buying tokens, by working, or by both. A buyer's effort is set by the token price, not by the career value it builds, so buying by lower types raises the signal higher types must post. High types can then work harder than before AI, while lower buyers work less, some below the full-information level. Workers gain only when welfare rises, but welfare can rise while workers lose, and the difference is the AI industry's profit. In education, where the submitted output has no value, all worker types lose. If workers are allowed to sell output as well as buy it, the token price is pinned to the value of output, the signal no longer depends on effort, and every type under-invests in skill. Token taxes, wage taxes, and watermarking all have ambiguous effects on welfare and on workers' payoffs, and what each achieves depends on whether workers can sell.
abstract_zh: 我们将人工智能产业引入一个职业信号模型，其中早期职业工作既传递工人能力信号，又构建其长期技能。该产业出售代币，工人将其转化为与自身产出无法区分的产品。在人工智能出现之前，市场能识别每种类型，信号激励引发一场竞逐，使努力超过完全信息水平。有了代币，市场仍能识别每种类型，工人通过购买代币、工作或两者兼用来分离。买方的努力由代币价格决定，而非由其构建的职业价值决定，因此低类型购买会抬高更高类型必须发出的信号。高类型随后可能比人工智能出现前更努力工作，而较低买方工作更少，一些人低于完全信息水平。工人只有在福利上升时才会获益，但福利可能在工人受损时上升，其差额即人工智能产业的利润。在教育中，提交的产出没有价值，所有工人类型都受损。如果允许工人既出售产出又购买代币，代币价格被钉在产出价值上，信号不再取决于努力，每种类型都投资于技能不足。代币税、工资税和水印对福利和工人收益都有模糊影响，各自实现什么取决于工人能否出售。

abstract: We introduce an open-source workflow that enables an LLM to reproduce, improve, and extend an economics article using the article’s published replication package. First, the workflow attempts to reproduce the original calculations, checks for discrepancies with published findings, and performs automated sensitivity analysis. Across 4,452 published replication packages for five economics journals, the workflow flags discrepancies in 3,460 articles or their appendices. Second, the workflow improves the original calculations by using a different implementation or algorithm. In 496 articles, the workflow is able to reduce a calculation’s computation time, at similar or greater accuracy, by more than a factor of 10. Third, the workflow extends the original analysis. In 923 articles, the workflow develops an extension that does not appear in the original article and that is aligned with the original article’s goals and assumptions.

abstract: This paper examines how geopolitical fragmentation disrupts carbon pricing effectiveness in China's clean energy markets. Utilizing a TVP-VAR-SV model (2013–2024), it identifies a significant “financial transmission penalty”, where trade conflicts reduce the positive transmission of carbon pricing signals on renewable energy market valuations by 30% to 70%. This paper demonstrates that this attenuation operates through a dual-channel mechanism. Substantively, trade tensions transform the “energy metals” channel from a positive amplifier into a net suppressor, as supply-chain volatility and critical mineral scarcity increase capital expenditures, squeezing policy dividends. Theoretically, it's argued that policy effectiveness is not merely a function of carbon-pricing design but hinges on how financial markets interpret the interaction between climate signals and geopolitical risks through risk premia and investor confidence. The results reveal a structural shift toward “new resource nationalism”, that green technological leadership paradoxically triggers strategic rivalry. This paper concludes and provides policy implications that sustaining decarbonization requires an adaptive framework integrating carbon pricing, mineral reserves, and financial resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地缘政治碎片化如何扰乱中国清洁能源市场中碳定价的有效性。本文运用TVP-VAR-SV模型（2013—2024年），识别出一种显著的“金融传导惩罚”，即贸易冲突使碳定价信号对可再生能源市场估值的正向传导降低了30%至70%。本文表明，这种衰减通过双重渠道机制发挥作用。在实质层面，贸易紧张局势使“能源金属”渠道从正向放大器转变为净抑制因素，因为供应链波动和关键矿产稀缺推高了资本支出，挤压了政策红利。在理论层面，本文认为政策有效性不仅是碳定价设计的函数，还取决于金融市场如何通过风险溢价和投资者信心来解读气候信号与地缘政治风险之间的相互作用。研究结果揭示了一种向“新资源民族主义”的结构性转变，即绿色技术领导地位 paradoxically 引发了战略竞争。本文得出结论并提供政策启示：维持脱碳需要一套整合碳定价、矿产储备和金融韧性的适应性框架。

abstract: Energy poverty is a central development and policy challenge because it restricts access to modern energy services, limits economic opportunity, and affects the inclusiveness of energy transitions. These concerns are increasingly salient as governments pursue environmental policy reforms under geopolitical fragmentation, conflict, and uneven institutional capacity. This paper examines the relationship between environmental policy stringency, conflict intensity, and energy poverty using a cross-country panel dataset covering 40 countries over the period 1997–2020. The empirical strategy relies on pooled regressions with time fixed effects and country-clustered standard errors, complemented by country fixed-effects specifications, heterogeneity analyses, Lewbel instrumental-variable estimates, and coefficient stability tests. The results indicate that structural economic conditions, particularly income levels and industrial capacity, are the most consistent determinants of energy poverty. While environmental policy stringency and conflict intensity are associated with energy poverty in some specifications, these relationships weaken once country-specific heterogeneity and identification concerns are accounted for. The interaction between policy stringency and conflict intensity provides limited support for a uniform causal mechanism through which geopolitical tensions systematically alter policy effectiveness. These findings contribute to the literature by highlighting the limits of policy-driven solutions to energy poverty in conflict-affected and geopolitically fragmented environments, and by emphasising the need for structural and institutional approaches alongside conventional environmental policy instruments.
abstract_zh: 能源贫困是一个核心的发展与政策挑战，因为它限制了现代能源服务的获取，制约了经济机会，并影响能源转型的包容性。随着各国在地缘政治碎片化、冲突和制度能力不均衡的背景下推进环境政策改革，这些关切日益凸显。本文使用涵盖1997—2020年40个国家的跨国面板数据集，考察环境政策严格程度、冲突强度与能源贫困之间的关系。实证策略依赖于带有时间固定效应和国家聚类标准误的混合回归，并辅以国家固定效应设定、异质性分析、Lewbel工具变量估计和系数稳定性检验。结果表明，结构性经济条件，尤其是收入水平和工业能力，是能源贫困最为一致的决定因素。尽管环境政策严格程度和冲突强度在某些设定中与能源贫困相关，但在考虑国家特定异质性和识别问题后，这些关系会减弱。政策严格程度与冲突强度之间的交互项仅为一种统一因果机制提供了有限支持，即地缘政治紧张会系统性地改变政策有效性。这些发现通过揭示在受冲突影响和地缘政治碎片化的环境中，政策驱动型能源贫困解决方案的局限性，并强调在常规环境政策工具之外还需结构性 and 制度性方法，为相关文献作出了贡献。
title: Energy policy and energy poverty under geopolitical fragmentation: Evidence on structural constraints

abstract: This paper presents a multi-temporal, multi-layered analysis of the configurational morphogenesis of Kutupalong refugee camp in Bangladesh as a critical case study. In particular, it investigates the configurational adaptations of the access network from incremental growth to rapid expansion, and the extent to which topography has enabled or constrained the network’s spatial transformations over time. The study adopts an exploratory approach and engages with a range of interconnected spatial variables. Using Space Syntax angular segment analysis at local and global radii, six time slices (2002–2025) are analysed for integration, choice, and intelligibility. A slope-range index from SRTM data quantifies terrain engagement at the segment level. The relationship between terrain and configuration is then interrogated at the level of individual access network segments through bivariate correlation, multivariate regression, and spatial autocorrelation diagnostics. The findings illustrate how the 2017 major influx marks a configurational rupture: local and global integration cores diverge, global choice axes reorient, and intelligibility falls significantly by 2025. Terrain associations with syntactic measures are statistically detectable but substantively negligible: elevation and slope add negligible explanatory power once segment length, building density, water, and road density are controlled for, and model residuals remain strongly spatially autocorrelated, so terrain effects are interpreted as exploratory rather than causal. The study shows how topography constrains but does not deterministically shape the network’s evolution under crisis conditions. The findings also suggest that as flatter terrain became saturated first, expansion increasingly encroached into steeper, more topographically challenging areas. Presenting a novel exploration of the dynamics between topography and configurational morphogenesis in a significantly large settlement, this study offers insights to inform more spatially grounded and contextually tailored upgrading interventions in displacement contexts.
abstract_zh: 本文以孟加拉国库图帕隆难民营为关键案例，对其配置形态发生进行了多时相、多层次分析。研究尤其考察了通行网络从增量增长到快速扩张过程中的配置适应，以及地形在多大程度上促成或约束了该网络随时间推移的空间转型。研究采用探索性方法，并纳入一系列相互关联的空间变量。运用空间句法角度线段分析，在局部与全局半径下，对六个时间切片（2002—2025年）的整合度、选择度和可理解度进行分析。基于SRTM数据的坡度范围指数在路段层面量化地形参与程度。随后，通过双变量相关、多变量回归和空间自相关诊断，在单个通行网络路段层面审视地形与配置之间的关系。研究发现表明，2017年的大规模涌入标志着一次配置断裂：局部与全局整合核心出现分化，全局选择轴线重新定向，而到2025年可理解度显著下降。地形与句法测度之间的关联在统计上可检测，但在实质上可忽略不计：在控制路段长度、建筑密度、水体和道路密度后，高程与坡度的解释力增加可忽略不计，且模型残差仍表现出强烈的空间自相关，因此地形效应被解释为探索性的，而非因果性的。研究表明，在危机条件下，地形约束但并非决定性地塑造了网络的演变。研究结果还表明，随着较平坦地形首先趋于饱和，扩张日益侵入更陡峭、地形上更具挑战性的区域。本研究对一个规模显著的大型聚居点中地形与配置形态发生之间的动态关系进行了新颖探索，为在流离失所情境中制定更具空间依据、更贴合具体情境的升级干预措施提供了见解。

abstract: We examine the claim that Pareto Dominance can evaluate efficiency-improving policies with long-lasting intergenerational consequences. Climate policies is a prime example, seeking to correct the externality that emitters of greenhouse gases do not pay for the future consequences of their emissions. However, climate policies lead to different identities of future people, ruling out a personal interpretation of Pareto Dominance. Assuming that there are infinitely many future people whose identities are not observable, we specify conditions under which their spatiotemporal positions do not matter and where rank-ordered streams play an important role. We justify Rank-Order Dominance whereby a world a rank-order dominates another world b if a Pareto dominates b for earlier born people and Suppes-Sen dominates b for future people, where one of the two need not be strict. We illustrate the controversial and even counterintuitive properties of this dominance relation for policy choice.
abstract_zh: 我们考察帕累托占优能够评估具有长期代际后果的效率改进政策这一主张。气候政策是一个典型例子，旨在纠正温室气体排放者不为自身排放的未来后果付费所导致的外部性。然而，气候政策会导致未来人的身份不同，从而排除了对帕累托占优作个人化解释的可能。假设存在无限多未来人且其身份不可观测，我们界定了一些条件，在这些条件下，他们的时空位置无关紧要，而按序排列的流则发挥重要作用。我们为按序占优提供辩护：若世界a对较早出生的人帕累托占优于世界b，且对未来人苏佩斯-森占优于世界b，则世界a按序占优于世界b，其中两者之一不必是严格的。我们说明这一占优关系在政策选择中所具有的有争议甚至反直觉的性质。

title: Evaluating intergenerational consequences by dominance: Efficiency when future identities are unobservable

abstract: This study investigates how information about intragenerational and intergenerational inequalities shapes fairness perceptions and policy preferences. Using a large-scale randomized survey experiment with 4900 respondents in Germany, we examine how exposure to information about wealth and age disparities affects (i) perceptions of distributive and intergenerational fairness, and (ii) support for redistributive and future-oriented policies. We find that roughly two thirds of respondents underestimate the extent of existing inequalities. Moreover, providing accurate information about wealth and age disparities has little effect on left-leaning and centrist respondents, but it produces a peculiar response among right-leaning individuals: the information increases their perceptions of the fairness of the status quo and reduces their support for redistributive and future-oriented policies. Overall, the findings suggest that informational interventions in politicized domains such as inequality may have limited effects when they are perceived as politically biased.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察关于代内不平等与代际不平等的信息如何塑造公平感知与政策偏好。我们利用一项在德国开展的大规模随机调查实验，涵盖4900名受访者，检验接触关于财富差距和年龄差距的信息如何影响：(i) 对分配公平与代际公平的感知，以及(ii) 对再分配政策和面向未来政策的支持。我们发现，约三分之二的受访者低估了现有不平等的程度。此外，提供关于财富差距和年龄差距的准确信息对左倾和中间派受访者影响甚微，但在右倾个体中产生了一种特殊反应：这些信息提高了他们对现状公平性的感知，并降低了他们对再分配政策和面向未来政策的支持。总体而言，研究结果表明，在不平等等高度政治化的领域中，信息干预若被视为具有政治偏见，其效果可能有限。

abstract: We study how willingness to pay for information depends on risk aversion when a decision maker faces background risk and can acquire information before choosing from a menu of assets. We distinguish investment menus, whose payoffs are procyclical with background wealth, from insurance menus, whose payoffs are countercyclical. Our main results show that the interaction between asset cyclicality and the tail geometry of background risk determines the direction of the comparative statics. When the density of background risk is log-concave, willingness to pay for information decreases with risk aversion for investment menus, whereas with downward-log-convex background risk it increases with risk aversion for insurance menus. The proofs compare the distributions of terminal wealth with and without information and develop new aggregation arguments for state-dependent single-crossing comparisons. We also construct reversals under strictly log-convex tails for investment menus and super-exponential left tails for insurance menus.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当决策者面临背景风险，并能在从资产菜单中做出选择之前获取信息时，其信息支付意愿如何取决于风险厌恶程度。我们将收益与背景财富同周期变动的投资菜单，与收益反周期变动的保险菜单区分开来。我们的主要结果表明，资产周期性与背景风险尾部几何形态之间的交互作用决定了比较静态的方向。当背景风险的密度为对数凹时，投资菜单的信息支付意愿随风险厌恶程度上升而下降；而当背景风险为向下对数凸时，保险菜单的信息支付意愿随风险厌恶程度上升而上升。证明比较了有信息与无信息条件下终端财富的分布，并为状态依赖的单交叉比较发展了新的聚合论证。我们还构造了投资菜单在严格对数凸尾部下以及保险菜单在超指数左尾下的反转。
title: Comparative Statics of Information Acquisition and Risk Aversion
title_zh: 信息获取与风险规避的比较静态分析

abstract: We study whether investor voice can help address global externalities under fragmented regulation. In our setting, a multinational firm generates externalities across jurisdictions, national regulators face political frictions that can impede corrective regulation, and policy differences create scope for regulatory arbitrage and production leakage. We compare two channels of investor influence: corporate stewardship, which affects firms' global operations, and policy advocacy, which affects local regulation. Both channels can help address global externalities, but their relative effectiveness depends on political frictions abroad. When these frictions are severe enough to prevent foreign regulation, leakage weakens policy advocacy but strengthens stewardship. When foreign regulation is politically feasible, however, stewardship can crowd out foreign regulation and reinforce policy miscoordination, while local policy advocacy can crowd in foreign regulation and reduce externalities abroad.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在监管碎片化的情况下，投资者发声能否有助于解决全球外部性问题。在我们的设定中，一家跨国公司跨司法辖区产生外部性，各国监管者面临可能阻碍纠正性监管的政治摩擦，而政策差异为监管套利和生产泄漏创造了空间。我们比较投资者影响的两种渠道：公司治理参与，其影响企业的全球运营；以及政策倡导，其影响地方监管。两种渠道都有助于解决全球外部性，但它们的相对有效性取决于国外的政治摩擦。当这些摩擦严重到足以阻止外国监管时，泄漏会削弱政策倡导，但会强化公司治理参与。然而，当外国监管在政治上可行时，公司治理参与可能挤出外国监管并强化政策不协调，而地方政策倡导则可能挤入外国监管并减少国外外部性。
title: Governing Global Externalities: Investor Voice Amid Fragmented Policy
title_zh: 治理全球外部性：政策碎片化中的投资者发声

abstract: The global adoption of IFRS 9 requires banks to recognize loan loss provisions based on forward-looking credit loss estimates. While these rules enhance the timeliness of loss recognition, they also expand the scope for managerial discretion in loss estimation. Using supervisory data on German banks’ internal rating models, we examine how banks respond to these countervailing incentives. Relative to unaffected banks, IFRS 9 adopters update their internal credit risk estimates more frequently, consistent with a general improvement in the timeliness of loss recognition, yet assign systematically more favorable internal ratings to otherwise identical borrowers. A lower precision of these ratings accompanies this pattern, consistent with the strategic use of increased re-porting discretion outweighing the greater timeliness of the estimates. The implications for bank lending are twofold. First, to counter the increased cost of high-risk lending, banks curtail credit to borrowers most likely to experience internal rating downgrades that would trigger additional provisioning in future periods, with these lending changes extending broadly across the non-investment-grade segment and indicating a general portfolio shift toward lower credit risk. Second, lending changes cluster around seemingly arbitrary provisioning thresholds where expected credit losses are systematically underreported, suggesting that expanded reporting discretion distorts lending in a way that optimizes model input rather than portfolio risk.
abstract_zh: IFRS 9的全球采用要求银行基于前瞻性信用损失估计确认贷款损失准备。尽管这些规则提高了损失确认的及时性，但也扩大了管理层在损失估计中的自由裁量空间。利用德国银行内部评级模型的监管数据，我们考察了银行如何应对这些相互抵消的激励。相对于未受影响的银行，采用IFRS 9的银行更频繁地更新其内部信用风险估计，这与损失确认及时性的总体改善相一致，但对其他方面相同的借款人系统性地给予更有利的内部评级。这些评级精度的下降与这一模式相伴出现，表明对增加的报告自由裁量权的策略性使用超过了估计及时性提高所带来的好处。对银行贷款的影响体现在两个方面。第一，为应对高风险贷款成本上升，银行削减对最可能经历内部评级下调——这将触发未来期间额外计提准备——的借款人的信贷，这些贷款变化广泛存在于非投资级板块，表明投资组合总体向较低信用风险转移。第二，贷款变化集中在看似任意的准备计提阈值附近，而在这些阈值处预期信用损失被系统性地低估，表明扩大的报告自由裁量权以优化模型输入而非投资组合风险的方式扭曲了贷款行为。
title: Forward-Looking Credit Loss Recognition and Banks’ Internal Risk Models
title_zh: 前瞻性信用损失确认与银行内部风险模型

abstract: How does experiencing direct investment loss affect individuals’ trust in the financial system? Exploiting recent UK corporate financial failures that generated press headlines, government debates and institutional criticisms, we design and analyse a survey involving investors in these failures. We find that direct exposure to investment losses significantly reduces trust in financial markets, regulators, big audit firms, and the likelihood of future risky asset market participation. Moreover, trust loss is not fully reversible even with possible compensation. Individual characteristics are not the key drivers of trust losses/gains either. We also survey master’s students exposed to reading about these failures. Information about losses of others reduces trust but less than direct experience. Overall, our results emphasize the role of personal experience in determining trust and future investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 直接经历投资损失会如何影响个人对金融体系的信任？利用近期英国企业财务失败事件所引发的新闻头条、政府辩论和制度批评，我们设计并分析了一项涵盖这些失败事件投资者的调查。我们发现，直接暴露于投资损失会显著降低对金融市场、监管机构、大型审计公司的信任，以及未来参与风险资产市场的可能性。此外，即使可能获得补偿，信任损失也并非完全可逆。个人特征也不是信任损失/恢复的关键驱动因素。我们还调查了阅读这些失败事件相关材料的硕士生。关于他人损失的信息会降低信任，但程度低于直接经历。总体而言，我们的结果强调了个人经历在决定信任和未来投资决策中的作用。
title: Trust and Investment Loss: Evidence from UK Financial Corporate Failures
title_zh: 信任与投资损失：来自英国金融公司破产的证据

abstract: Appointing more women to corporate boards is widely expected to also raise firms' environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. We provide the first meta-analysis of this relationship, drawing on 533 estimates from 106 studies that measure ESG performance with Bloomberg or LSEG ratings. The average reported effect of a one-percentage-point increase in board gender diversity is about 0.28 ESG points, but much of it does not survive scrutiny. Correcting for publication bias with a battery of linear and non-linear methods lowers the effect to between roughly 0.08 and 0.17 points. A best-practice estimate that also imposes sound study design puts it near 0.12 for most of the world, markedly higher for the Middle East, and near -0.11 for the Southeast Asian markets that dominate the Asian evidence. The differences that remain across studies are systematic, driven mainly by geography and by the choice of estimation method rather than by the ESG-rating provider or the controls a study includes. Board gender diversity may be well worth pursuing on its own merits, but the evidence that it reliably raises ESG scores is weaker than the published record suggests.
abstract_zh: 任命更多女性进入公司董事会被普遍预期也会提升企业的环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现。我们提供了关于这一关系的首个元分析，基于106项研究中的533个估计值，这些研究使用彭博或伦敦证券交易所集团（LSEG）评级来衡量ESG表现。董事会性别多样性每提高一个百分点，平均报告效应约为0.28个ESG分，但其中很大一部分经不起推敲。使用一系列线性和非线性方法校正发表偏倚后，该效应降至约0.08至0.17分之间。一项同时施加严谨研究设计的最佳实践估计显示，全球大部分地区该效应接近0.12，中东地区明显更高，而在主导亚洲证据的东南亚市场则接近-0.11。研究之间残留的差异是系统性的，主要由地理区域和估计方法的选择驱动，而非由ESG评级提供方或研究纳入的控制变量驱动。董事会性别多样性或许因其自身价值而很值得追求，但其可靠提升ESG评分的证据比已发表记录所显示的更弱。
title: Do Female Directors Raise ESG Ratings? A Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 女性董事是否提升ESG评级？一项元分析

abstract: We show that following the diffusion of GenAI, industries with higher task-level exposure experience 20% more startup formation than less-exposed industries, and a growing share of these startups offer AI products rather than merely automating operations. Entry extends beyond innovation hubs into regions with limited venture capital and thin specialized labor markets. While individual entrants are smaller, aggregate entry generates net employment and wage growth at the industry level, including in the occupations most exposed to GenAI. GenAI also changes who becomes an entrepreneur: founders are more specialized, come from high-GenAI-exposure occupations, and emphasize technical skills rather than capital-raising expertise.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，随着生成式人工智能的扩散，任务层面暴露度更高的行业，其初创企业形成数量比暴露度较低的行业高出20%，并且这些初创企业中提供人工智能产品的比例不断上升，而非仅仅实现运营自动化。这种进入不仅限于创新中心，还扩展到风险资本有限、专业劳动力市场薄弱的地区。尽管单个进入者规模较小，但总体进入在行业层面产生了净就业和工资增长，包括在受生成式人工智能影响最深的职业中。生成式人工智能还改变了谁成为创业者：创始人更加专业化，来自生成式人工智能高暴露职业，并强调技术技能而非融资专长。
title: Prompted to Start: How Generative AI is Transforming Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 被提示的创业：生成式人工智能如何改变创业

abstract: We study the macroeconomic and trade-policy implications of disruptions to U.S.-bound shipping routes. Standard models treat them as iceberg-cost shocks, conflating the shock with the response to it. Using satellite vessel-tracking data, we construct route-level measures of potential and effective capacity for all U.S.-bound container ships from 2016 to 2025. Utilization losses in recent disruptions ran 20 to 40 percentage points, and began months before port congestion became visible. We embed these measures in a general equilibrium model in which firms reallocate a common fleet without internalizing the congestion they create and price above marginal cost, while importers' sourcing responds to route profitability. The reallocation triggered by a disruption then has first-order welfare effects, and the route's Domar weight is not a sufficient statistic for its welfare cost. The 2021 West Coast crisis and the 2023-2024 Red Sea attacks cost 0.69% and 0.35% of output. Naval protection of Red Sea shipping generated benefits of 0.04-0.08% of output at a fiscal cost of 0.02%. Tariffs decongest the routes they tax, offsetting or even reversing their conventional welfare cost.
abstract_zh: 我们研究美国方向航运路线中断的宏观经济与贸易政策影响。标准模型将其视为冰山成本冲击，从而将冲击与其引致的响应混为一谈。利用卫星船舶追踪数据，我们构建了2016年至2025年所有美国方向集装箱船的路线层面潜在运力与有效运力指标。近期中断中的利用率损失达20至40个百分点，且在港口拥堵显现之前数月便已开始。我们将这些指标嵌入一个一般均衡模型，其中企业在未内部化其造成的拥堵的情况下重新配置共同船队，并以高于边际成本定价，而进口商的采购则对路线盈利能力作出反应。中断所触发的重新配置因而具有一阶福利效应，且路线的多马权重并非其福利成本的充分统计量。2021年西海岸危机和2023—2024年红海袭击分别造成产出0.69%和0.35%的成本。对红海航运的海军保护产生了产出0.04—0.08%的收益，财政成本为0.02%。关税会缓解其所征税路线的拥堵，从而抵消甚至逆转其常规福利成本。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国航线航运中断、美国进口与贸易政策，数据为美国方向集装箱船，制度背景为美国及红海，不涉及中国。
title: Shipping to America
title_zh: 运往美国

abstract: This paper develops a Beveridgean model of the Phillips curve. While the New Keynesian Phillips curve is based on monopolistic pricing under price-adjustment costs, the Beveridgean Phillips curve is based on directed-search pricing under price-adjustment costs. Under directed search, prices respond to slack instead of marginal costs. The resulting Phillips curve has three properties that match recent US evidence. First, it delivers the divine coincidence: inflation is on target whenever unemployment is at its efficient level—the full-employment rate of unemployment (FERU), the geometric mean of the unemployment and vacancy rates. Second, it is decreasing and convex in the unemployment-inflation plane: inflation responds more strongly to unemployment when the labor market is inefficiently tight than when it is inefficiently slack. The convexity is inherited from the Beveridge curve, which makes unemployment a decreasing and convex function of tightness. Third, shifts of the Beveridge curve move the FERU and therefore shift the unemployment-inflation Phillips curve. The model also implies that the Fed's dual mandate is internally consistent, that a soft landing from an inefficiently tight labor market is possible, and that the zero lower bound is not topsy-turvy.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个贝弗里奇式的菲利普斯曲线模型。新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线基于价格调整成本下的垄断定价，而贝弗里奇菲利普斯曲线则基于价格调整成本下的定向搜寻定价。在定向搜寻下，价格对松弛程度而非边际成本作出反应。由此得到的菲利普斯曲线具有三个与美国近期证据相符的性质。第一，它实现了神圣巧合：当失业率处于其有效水平——即充分就业失业率（FERU），亦即失业率与职位空缺率的几何平均值——时，通胀处于目标水平。第二，它在失业-通胀平面上是递减且凸的：当劳动力市场无效率地紧张时，通胀对失业的反应比劳动力市场无效率地松弛时更为强烈。这种凸性继承自贝弗里奇曲线，后者使失业成为紧张程度的递减且凸的函数。第三，贝弗里奇曲线的移动会改变FERU，从而移动失业-通胀菲利普斯曲线。该模型还意味着，美联储的双重使命在内部是一致的，从无效率地紧张的劳动力市场实现软着陆是可能的，且零下限并非颠倒错乱。
title: Beveridgean Phillips Curve
title_zh: 贝弗里奇菲利普斯曲线

abstract: This paper documents large indirect mortality impacts of climate change. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1°C of warming increases annual mortality by 2.5 deaths per 1,000 individuals, compared to 0.1 deaths per 1,000 due to the associated local heat exposure. Using external estimates of the impact of global income on mortality, we show that the macroeconomic effects of global temperature changes explain two thirds of the gap between these estimates. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model that links mortality and economic activity and accounts for adaptation to mortality impacts. Mortality contributes $400 per ton of CO₂ to the Social Cost of Carbon, or one quarter of total climate damages. These results suggest that economic adaptation has a double dividend by also reducing climate-related mortality.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了气候变化带来的巨大间接死亡率影响。利用全球自然温度变异性，我们发现升温1°C会使年死亡率增加每千人2.5例死亡，而与之相关的局部高温暴露仅导致每千人0.1例死亡。利用全球收入对死亡率影响的外部估计，我们表明全球温度变化的宏观经济效应解释了这些估计之间差距的三分之二。我们利用这一证据，在新古典增长模型中估计损害函数，该模型将死亡率与经济活动和适应死亡率影响联系起来。死亡率对碳的社会成本贡献为每吨二氧化碳400美元，占气候总损害的四分之一。这些结果表明，经济适应具有双重红利，因为它还能降低与气候相关的死亡率。
title: Global Temperature and Global Mortality
title_zh: 全球气温与全球死亡率

abstract: Standard macroeconomic theories assume that representative or heterogeneous agents share a common model of how the economy operates. Yet evidence shows that households hold heterogeneous subjective models---distinct beliefs about how macroeconomic variables interact. As a result, identical shocks or policies may elicit different responses from otherwise similar households. We test this hypothesis by measuring subjective models and investigating their role in the transmission of monetary policy to consumption embedding randomized controlled experiment in a large-scale, multi-country survey. Consumers who believe that monetary tightening primarily operates through its effects on borrowing or savings rates plan to reduce consumption more in response to randomly assigned rate increase scenarios. By contrast, those who think about inflation or general equilibrium effects adjust consumption less. These differences are not explained by demographics, financial characteristics, including mortgage holdings and mortgage type, or country-level factors. Households' actual consumption responses to endogenous policy-rate changes exhibit broadly similar patterns. Our findings stress that heterogeneity in subjective models is an overlooked determinant of monetary policy transmission.
abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济理论假设，代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而，证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过测量主观模型，并在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验，考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，以检验这一假说。认为货币紧缩主要通过其对借贷利率或储蓄利率的影响发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的利率上升情景下，计划更多地减少消费。相比之下，那些考虑通胀或一般均衡效应的消费者，对消费的调整较少。这些差异无法由人口统计特征、金融特征（包括抵押贷款持有情况和抵押贷款类型）或国家层面因素解释。家庭对内生政策利率变化的实际消费反应也呈现出大体相似的模式。我们的发现强调，主观模型的异质性是货币政策传导中被忽视的决定因素。
title: Subjective Models of the Macroeconomy and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 宏观经济的主观模型与货币政策传导

abstract: Should a jurisdiction seeking to cut greenhouse gas emissions use demand-side climate policies that target fossil fuel consumption? Or should it introduce supply-side policies that target extraction? My analysis points to a policy portfolio rather than an either/or choice. ``Leakage'' of emissions to unregulated jurisdictions can be mitigated by combining standard demand-side carbon emissions pricing with supply-side pricing of carbon extraction. Emissions pricing drives leakage by lowering fossil fuel prices abroad; extraction pricing counteracts this effect. Supply-side climate policies in practice, however, do not broadly price extraction but instead narrowly foreclose investments in fossil fuel infrastructure and are thus inefficient. To reduce carbon demand, an alternative to emissions pricing is support for clean energy. I emphasize reforms to transmission planning and utility governance as crucial for unlocking clean energy resources' potential, and I highlight the case for publicly supporting clean energy R&D, including green industrial policy, to reduce carbon emissions not just at home but also abroad. I close by discussing distributional consequences. Domestically, carbon pricing and clean energy subsidies have sharply different distributional profiles. Globally, carbon extraction pricing would harm low-income countries that are also fossil fuel importers, though there also exist low-income fossil fuel exporters that would benefit.
abstract_zh: 一个寻求削减温室气体排放的司法管辖区，应当采用针对化石燃料消费的需求侧气候政策，还是应当引入针对化石燃料开采的供给侧政策？我的分析指向一种政策组合，而非非此即彼的选择。通过将标准的碳需求侧排放定价与碳开采的供给侧定价相结合，可以缓解排放向未受监管司法管辖区的“泄漏”。排放定价会通过压低国外化石燃料价格而驱动泄漏；开采定价则抵消这一效应。然而，实践中的供给侧气候政策并不广泛地对开采进行定价，而是狭隘地排除对化石燃料基础设施的投资，因而效率低下。为减少碳需求，排放定价的替代方案是支持清洁能源。我强调，输电规划和公用事业治理改革对于释放清洁能源资源的潜力至关重要，并强调有理由对清洁能源研发提供公共支持，包括绿色产业政策，以不仅在国内而且在国外减少碳排放。最后，我讨论了分配后果。在国内，碳定价和清洁能源补贴具有截然不同的分配特征。在全球层面，碳开采定价会损害那些同时也是化石燃料进口国的低收入国家，不过也存在一些将从中受益的低收入化石燃料出口国。
china_relevance_reason: 论文讨论一般性的气候政策（需求侧与供给侧），未涉及中国、中国企业、中国人群或中国制度背景，研究对象和数据均非中国。
title: Economics of Demand-Side and Supply-Side Climate Policies
title_zh: 需求侧与供给侧气候政策的经济学

abstract: Importers are few and large, have higher labor productivity and pass through cost changes to prices incompletely. We study optimal tariffs in a model consistent with these facts. Firms pay a fixed cost to import and charge markups that increase with size. Market power implies that importers are too few and too small relative to the efficient allocations. Tariffs amplify this distortion. We derive a formula that relates the optimal tariff not only to the foreign export supply elasticity but also to how much distortions amplify the effect of trade costs on welfare. In our calibrated economy the optimal tariff is negative and decreases with country size.
abstract_zh: 进口商数量少且规模大，具有更高的劳动生产率，并将成本变化不完全地传导至价格。我们在一个与这些事实一致的模型中研究最优关税。企业支付固定成本以进行进口，并收取随规模增加而提高的加成。市场势力意味着相对于有效配置，进口商数量过少且规模过小。关税放大了这一扭曲。我们推导出一个公式，将最优关税不仅与外国出口供给弹性相关联，还与扭曲在多大程度上放大贸易成本对福利的影响相关联。在我们的校准经济中，最优关税为负，并随国家规模增大而降低。
china_relevance_reason: 研究为一般性最优关税理论模型，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景。
title: Importers, Market Power and Optimal Tariffs
title_zh: 进口商、市场势力与最优关税

abstract: How much liability should AI providers bear when their services enable both attack and defence? Liability can improve welfare while increasing harm. Providers sell a common input to productive users, attackers and defenders. Within a defended contest, a higher common price reduces effort without changing attack success or attacker profits, saving resources and improving the target's security payoff. Compensation weakens defence and raises attacker profits. Optimal liability balances these effects against productive exclusion. Greater competition can lower optimal liability; every such decline must end at an outcome retaining defence. With cybersecurity access fixed, monopoly can warrant partial liability but never full liability when provision is worthwhile. When guardrails preserving productive uses are available, strong competition favours universal guarding socially but encourages unilateral removal at insufficient liability. At a fixed provider count, sufficiently many productive users ensure a pure equilibrium with universal guarding under high liability. A universal-guarding requirement makes liability redundant. Under monopoly, adoption follows a unique liability threshold, while zero liability remains uniquely optimal for a range of parameters with sufficiently many productive users.
abstract_zh: 当AI服务既可被用于攻击也可被用于防御时，AI提供者应承担多少责任？责任可以提高福利，同时也会增加伤害。提供者向生产性用户、攻击者和防御者出售一种共同投入。在一个有防御的竞争中，较高的共同价格会减少努力，却不改变攻击成功率或攻击者利润，从而节省资源并改善目标的安全收益。补偿会削弱防御并提高攻击者利润。最优责任在这些效应与生产性排斥之间进行权衡。竞争加剧可能降低最优责任；每一次这样的下降都必须终止于一个仍保留防御的结果。在网络安全访问固定的情况下，当提供具有价值时，垄断可以支持部分责任，但绝不能支持完全责任。当能够保留生产性用途的护栏可用时，强竞争在社会意义上倾向于普遍护栏，但在责任不足时又会鼓励单方面移除护栏。在提供者数量固定时，足够多的生产性用户可确保在高责任下存在普遍护栏的纯均衡。普遍护栏要求使责任变得多余。在垄断下，采用遵循一个唯一的责任阈值，而在生产性用户足够多的参数范围内，零责任仍然唯一最优。
title: Liability and Pricing of Dual-Use AI
title_zh: 双重用途人工智能的责任与定价

abstract: What caused the historically unique volatility in American homicides since 2019, driven by gun homicides? While there is no shortage of candidate explanations, a coherent understanding has been elusive because of the widely held view that gun violence, like other crimes, stems from a rational weighing of benefits and costs as in Becker (1968). This model does a generally poor job of explaining recent trends in homicide. Behavioral economics helps explain what the Becker model cannot. This view starts with the fact that most shootings don’t further some larger goal like robbery or gang wars over drug turf (“instrumental violence”); they’re arguments settled with guns (“expressive violence”). Why do arguments start or escalate? The behavioral model points to automatic cognition that is fast, effortless but sometimes prone to error. The pandemic increased automaticity by increasing distress – a cognitive “bandwidth tax.” Recent homicide trends, driven by changes in expressive violence, are mirrored by similar trends for deaths from drug overdose, car crashes, and suicide (especially for Black Americans, the group most affected by violence) – “deaths of decision-making.” Also relevant is a large rise and fall in gun carrying, which might partially stem from Becker-like mechanisms: Large changes in handgun sales and police stops, both of which may also have been affected by the killing of George Floyd. Since American gun violence is mostly arguments with guns, no wonder homicide trends are due mostly to changes in the number of arguments and the odds a given argument had a gun present.
abstract_zh: 2019年以来，是什么导致了美国凶杀案出现历史上独一无二的波动，且主要由枪支凶杀驱动？尽管候选解释并不缺乏，但由于人们普遍认为枪支暴力与其他犯罪一样，源于像Becker（1968）那样对收益与成本的理性权衡，连贯的理解一直难以形成。该模型在解释近期凶杀趋势方面总体表现不佳。行为经济学有助于解释Becker模型无法解释的内容。这一观点始于一个事实：大多数枪击并不服务于某种更大的目标，比如抢劫或因毒品地盘而起的帮派战争（“工具性暴力”）；它们是用枪支解决的争执（“表达性暴力”）。争执为何开始或升级？行为模型指向快速、毫不费力但有时容易出错的自动认知。疫情通过增加痛苦——一种认知上的“带宽税”——提高了自动性。近期由表达性暴力变化驱动的凶杀趋势，与药物过量、车祸和自杀死亡（尤其是黑人美国人，这一受暴力影响最大的群体）的类似趋势相呼应——“决策之死”。同样相关的还有携枪的大幅上升与下降，这可能部分源于类似Becker的机制：手枪销售和警察拦截的大幅变化，二者也可能受到乔治·弗洛伊德被杀事件的影响。由于美国的枪支暴力大多是带枪的争执，难怪凶杀趋势主要归因于争执数量的变化以及某一争执发生时现场有枪的概率变化。
title: Crime in Covid Times
title_zh: 新冠时期的犯罪

abstract: Development accounting is the search for proximate sources of cross-country income differences. This article describes how knowledge in this field has evolved over the two decades since the influential work of Caselli (2005). There have been large advances in the measurement of production inputs (labor, physical capital, and human capital). These advances have raised the estimated contribution of inputs, mostly human capital, in development accounting. Our preferred estimate is that inputs account for 50--65 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) per worker differences, versus 30 percent using the classic specification. The literature has also made progress in moving away from Cobb-Douglas production functions and measuring factors such as management quality that were previously bundled into total factor productivity (TFP). Our review highlights the new implications of these advances, areas where future research would be beneficial, and the limitations of development accounting.
abstract_zh: 发展核算旨在寻找跨国收入差异的直接来源。本文描述了自Caselli（2005）这一有影响力的研究问世以来的二十年间，该领域知识是如何演变的。在生产投入（劳动、物质资本和人力资本）的测度方面已取得重大进展。这些进展提高了投入在发展核算中的估计贡献，主要是人力资本。我们倾向的估计是，投入解释了每工人国内生产总值（GDP）差异的50%–65%，而使用经典设定则为30%。该文献还在摆脱柯布–道格拉斯生产函数、以及测度此前被归入全要素生产率（TFP）的诸如管理质量等因素方面取得了进展。我们的综述强调了这些进展的新含义、未来研究将大有裨益的领域，以及发展核算的局限性。
title: Accounting for Cross-Country Income Differences Revisited
title_zh: 重新审视跨国收入差异的核算

abstract: This study examines a housing program that created affordable infill developments on formerly vacant, abandoned, or disinvested properties in Savannah, Georgia. Savannah is a major economic hub anchored by the Port of Savannah, where many urban neighborhoods remain impacted by disinvestment and climate risk. Using two decades of record-linked property and tax data, this study quantifies local economic spillovers from this public intervention, revealing previously hidden social and economic benefits of infill housing policies. These benefits include an 11% increase in the market value of properties immediately neighboring an infill development site and an increase of up to 35% in areas with a high density of infill activity, pointing to block-level revitalization in climate-disadvantaged and distressed areas.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了佐治亚州萨凡纳市一项住房项目，该项目在先前空置、废弃或投资撤离的用地上开发了可负担的填充式住宅。萨凡纳是以萨凡纳港为依托的主要经济中心，当地许多城市社区仍受到投资撤离和气候风险的影响。本研究利用二十年记录关联的房产与税收数据，量化了这项公共干预带来的本地经济溢出效应，揭示了填充式住房政策此前未被发现的社会与经济收益。这些收益包括：紧邻填充式开发地块的房产市场价值提高了11%，而在填充式活动高度密集的区域，增幅最高可达35%，表明在气候不利和困境地区出现了街区层面的复兴。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国佐治亚州萨凡纳市的住房填充开发项目，数据、制度与政策背景均为美国，不涉及中国。
title: The Positive Spillovers to Risky Investments in Vacant, Abandoned, and Disinvested Properties
title_zh: 空置、废弃和撤资房产风险投资的正向溢出效应

abstract: Many population projections used by international and government agencies assume that, in today's low-fertility societies, future fertility rates will stop declining and roughly stabilize. This paper assesses the evidence for an equilibrium point or rebound from low levels. We show that there is no robust evidence for a systematic fertility rebound, or for a stable equilibrium point at any fertility level conventionally assumed. Instead, where and when fertility has fallen low, it has tended to keep falling. This is true across a range of data sources, time periods, and fertility measures: United Nations data on period total fertility rates for all country-years from 1950 to 2023; Human Fertility Database data on completed fertility for cohorts born between 1935 and 1975 in 31 countries; and fertility rates in subnational geographies in Japan, India, and the United States. We reconcile these results with a prior literature that documented fertility reversals among some low-fertility countries in the early 2000s. Our findings provide an empirical basis for re-examining the equilibrium and rebound assumptions embedded in widely used population projections.
abstract_zh: 许多国际机构和政府机构使用的人口预测都假设，在当今低生育率社会中，未来生育率将停止下降并大致趋于稳定。本文评估了关于低生育率均衡点或从低水平反弹的证据。我们表明，没有稳健证据支持系统性的生育率反弹，也没有证据支持在通常假设的任何生育率水平上存在稳定均衡点。相反，在生育率已降至低水平的地方和时期，它往往持续下降。这一点在一系列数据来源、时间段和生育率指标中都成立：联合国关于1950年至2023年所有国家—年份的时期总和生育率数据；人类生育率数据库关于31个国家1935年至1975年出生队列的已完成生育率数据；以及日本、印度和美国次国家地理区域的生育率。我们将这些结果与先前文献相协调，后者记录了2000年代初一些低生育率国家出现的生育率逆转。我们的发现为重新审视广泛使用的人口预测中嵌入的均衡和反弹假设提供了经验基础。
title: Does Fertility Stabilize At Low Levels? Evidence from Period, Cohort, and Subnational Data
title_zh: 生育率会在低水平上趋于稳定吗？来自时期、队列和次国家数据的证据

abstract: This paper studies the effects of population growth on welfare in an OLG model, in which lower population growth raises output per worker but also reduces the ratio of workers to retirees. Under fairly mild restrictions on the model’s parameters, there exists an optimal population-growth rate—one that maximizes steady-state welfare. This growth rate may well be negative: it may be optimal for the population to shrink over time. The introduction of a pay-as-you-go social security system reduces the optimal population-growth rate.
title: Optimal Population Growth in the Diamond OLG Model
title_zh: 钻石世代交叠模型中的最优人口增长

abstract: We show that the dollar remains dominant in most aspects of global finance. The euro and renminbi are competing in an increasingly fragmented second tier of currencies, leaving no clear rivals to the dollar. We study how financial innovation could reshape the international monetary system. In principle, innovation levels the playing field between countries, for instance by reducing the need for vehicle currencies to intermediate transactions between other currency pairs and by making it easier to acquire and trade foreign assets. We show that an alternative outcome is more likely. Innovations that reduce frictions in cross-border transactions, especially dollar-backed payment stablecoins and other forms of tokenization of money, could interact with relative market thickness to reinforce the dollar’s dominance. This outcome is not preordained but depends on other countries’ willingness to embrace innovations and strengthen their financial markets and regulatory frameworks. While unipolarity has many disadvantages, we show that in some circumstances multipolarity might result in greater global fragility at times of financial market stress.
